reason: ₹1,999 every month is about a tenth of what we earn, and right now every spare rupee is going to the wedding and school fees. My wife and I wash by hand and it costs nothing, so I cannot take on an EMI for clothes washing.
objection: Two thousand a month for a whole year when hand-washing is free. We barely even have a washer problem to solve. And if the battery dies after the warranty, who pays for a new one?
would_change_my_mind: If the EMI came down to about ₹800-900 a month, after the wedding is done and money is less tight
